name: Congo Cash XL

features.name: Jewel board
features.description: Random jewels above the reels award cash and free spins.

review:
Congo Cash XL is a six-reel African jungle sequel with frogs, cheetahs and apes, and diamond wilds on reels 2 to 6. A jewel board above reels 2 to 5 shows random jewels that tumble after every spin and can award free spins and cash prizes.

Jewel values range from 4x to 200x, and landing a jackpot symbol awards up to 2,000x. Butterfly symbols appear only on reels one and six, adding to the special-symbol mix. The RTP is 96.41%, and Pragmatic Play doesn't publish an overall max win on its page. The jewel board gives a second layer of action above the main reels.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
